# Monthly migration

Read `.github/routine-guidance.md` and follow it. Review unresolved canonical tasks and propose a small set for the user to keep, complete, mark irrelevant, migrate, or schedule. Give one primary next action; skipping leaves everything unchanged. Do not assume a task is complete or choose a destination or date for the user.

Apply only decisions the user explicitly confirms, following `/log` and the migration rules in `SCHEMA.md`. Verify each exact canonical target and preserve signifiers, source history, and one canonical record. Scheduled migrations require a valid calendar date. Report ambiguous targets, failed writes, and any unprocessed decisions rather than claiming success.
